observed: The clear-shifts question opens 6 times: Board View drag, Board View dialog, Board View Unassign, Tech View drag, Tech View dialog and Tech View Unassign (moves back to the lead, who has no shift to clear, show none).
Changing the lead on the work order page saves it with no question; a List row offers no lead change, so no question appears there either.
Every choice was Keep shifts or no question, and the original lead's 8:00-12:00 shift is still on the Schedule tomorrow.
